steps.title: Another request on this vault, 2026-11-11 at 20:46 UTC: the owner's own test spend. It needs a second signature, and a public NEAR contract makes it wait.

lines.text: The contract set its unlock 10:00 later: requested 20:46:33 UTC, unlocks 20:56:33 UTC. A new destination, with no guard online.

steps.title: The phone page's Cancel stops a thief's request. Another test vault of the same contract, the same day.

steps.title: Back on the first vault, the request of 2026-11-11 at 20:46 UTC, the owner's own test spend: nobody cancelled it. Once it unlocked, the contract asked for Bitcoin's second signature.

lines.text: Mined with two signatures: the spend key's, and the one NEAR Chain Signatures gave.
